1. 1907 draft scheme. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
2. Five Neutral Powers. Each member may nominate a number of candidates equal to the number of vacancies and not less than half the number; in no case less than three. (art. 6)
3. Interparliamentary Union. Each Power has the right to present as many candidates as there are seats to be filled. (art. 12)
4. International Law Union. Not more than three for each state. (art. 4)
5. Denmark. Each Government may nominate a number of candidates equal to the number of vacancies and not less than half that number. (art. 3)
6. Norway. Each Government may nominate a number of candidates equal to the number of vacancies. (art. 3)
7. Netherlands. Each judicial body, Faculty of Law and Government recommends not more than two persons. (art. 3)
8. Sweden. Same as Denmark.
9. Switzerland. Each state proposes at least one and at most four candidates. (art. 13)
10. Italy. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
11. Germany. Same as Switzerland. (art. 14)
12. Austria. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
